sections.text:

*Bludgeon

*Drift

*Necrotronus (20 or more Titan Charges)
*Optimus Primal (Special Attack 1 and 2)
*Optimus Prime (Breach signature ability on critical attacks on Armor Break)

*Scorponok

parsed.lead:
Burn is a Damaging Debuff is an ability that deals heat damage over time, as indicated in-game by flames on the affected bot.

Should not be confused with Dark Burn, which inflicts instant debuff damage.

sections.heading: Bots with Burn Abilities
sections.text:
Burns are inflicted by missiles and anything that shoots fire.
* Grimlock - Heavy Attacks (40~63%), Special 1 and 3
* Grindor - Critical Heavy Attacks and Special 3
* Hound - Inferno Ammo shots, Special 1 and 2
* Ironhide - all missile attacks
* Mixmaster - Special 2 and 3
* Ramjet - Special 1 and 2
* Sideswipe - Special 2 and 3
* Starscream - Heavy Attacks (20%)
* Tantrum - Special 1 +10% for each Melee Buff
* Thundercracker - Heavy Attacks for each debuff purified
* Ultra Magnus - Heavy, Attack, Special 2 and 3
* Waspinator - Special 3

sections.heading: Counter Bots
sections.text:
* Grimlock
* Optimus Primal + Beast Purification Synergy
* Mirage
* Rhinox (35% Burn and Shock Resistance while Shielded)
* Jetfire
* Thundercracker
* Tantrum

sections.heading: Infliction
sections.text:
* Transwarp Cell
* Burn Down
* Boss Megatronus at Relic of Chaos

sections.heading: Strong Match-Ups
sections.text:
* Pyrophobia
* Burn It

parsed.lead:
Shock is a damaging debuff ability which deals Shock damage over time.

Not to be confused with Instant Shock damage.

sections.heading: Characteristics
sections.text: Shock damage is characterized as a Bot being shocked with some kind of electricity charge.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: Some Brawler Bots work around Bleeds to gain ground, but some don't work around Shocks. Use this to your advantage to take down tough Brawlers.

sections.heading: Bots that inflict Shock damage
sections.text:
* Thundercracker (Special 3)
* Scorponok (3 or more Venom Backfires expire)
* Bumblebee (Shield Break)
*Kickback (Special 1)
*Windblade (Special 1)
*Jetfire (Heavy & Special 3)
*Wheeljack (Special Attacks)
*Blaster (Heavy)
*Shockwave (Heavy, Special 1 & 3)
*Soundwave (Heavy, Special 2 & 3)
*Ratchet (Ranged Attacks)
*Rhinox (From his "Overclock" signature)
*Megatron (Special 3)
*Bumblebee (DOTM) - (Special 2 & 3)

as_of_2023.raw_wikitext:
'''Evasion''' buffs are abilities that makes a Bot automatically dodge attacks. Three types of Evade exist: '''Melee Evade''' and '''Ranged Evade''', in addition to a '''general Evade'''.

== Bots with this buff ==
*All [[Scout]]s have this buff in one way or another.
* [[Bumblebee (DOTM)]] is the only non-Scout to have an Evade buff.
[[Category:Buffs]]
[[Category:Gameplay]]

parsed.lead: Evasion buffs are abilities that makes a Bot automatically dodge away from attacks. Evade can be attack specific: Evade Melee, Evade Ranged, and Evade Special , in addition to Evade All. Some bots have instances of Evading instantly without buffs.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
* Arcee (instant ranged)
* Barricade (all)
* Bumblebee (DOTM) (melee or ranged) 
* Bumblebee (melee)
* Cheetor (ranged)
* Jazz (all)
* Kickback (instant heavy)
* Prowl (all)
* Sideswipe (melee)
* Skywarp (specials)
* Starscream (instant heavy melee, synergy ranged)
* Sunstreaker (melee)

Some modules like the Nightbird's Mark can add evade buff to any bot.

Category:Buffs
Category:Gameplay
